purpose: Public machine-readable commerce contract for partners and shopping agents.

fee_policy.note: Listed NZD price is what the buyer pays for the offer. Stripe processing fees are separate.

economic_event.rule: A checkout start is not revenue. Verified revenue requires external Stripe payment evidence plus fulfillment proof.
economic_event.client_reference: Pass product_id as Stripe client_reference_id via /buy/{product_id} when possible.

how_to_buy: Present name, price, currency, and checkout_url to the human buyer
Require human authorization before any spend (no autonomous spend)
Open checkout_url (or https://dreamledger.org/buy/{product_id} for client_reference_id binding)
Treat economic event as paid only after Stripe confirms payment; then deliver and prove

primary_offers.name: Edward Kenway Commander Deck
primary_offers.delivery: Physical Commander deck, NZ shipping address collected, seller dispatch proof required

primary_offers.name: DreamLedger Internet Billboard
primary_offers.delivery: One public digital placement after content approval. Successful payment alone is not publication proof; verified published placements currently zero.

primary_offers.name: Supplier Quote Comparison
primary_offers.delivery: Structured CSV and summary after operator reviews buyer-provided supplier quotes; allow 24h after complete intake.

catalog_note: These links reflect the inspected public listing and live checkout state; buyers must review final price, stock and terms. No completed buyer, receipt, or delivery is implied.
public_boundary: Customer- and partner-facing. Internal ops language excluded.

marketplace.purchase_rule: Discovery and cart preparation may be automated. Purchase requires separately approved authority.
marketplace.truth_rule: Settled external payment plus fulfillment plus independent evidence is required before verified economic truth.
